description: A lightweight snapshot of one conversation: reads live state from this server's memory without spawning a DSH process. Returns state (running/idle/detached), the current tool and output size while running, the latest turn's run_id, status and review status, pending approvals, queue length, and the write-lock holder lock_holder (when you hit the lock, use it to choose between dsh_takeover and asking the other side to dsh_release). For a turn's full result use dsh_get, for live output dsh_read, for all conversations dsh_list.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.
